rationale: The current-reading policy applies to “current.” e1 identifies Paul Hollis as incumbent since 2026-01-05 and identifies David Motl’s acting tenure as ending in 2018. However, the reference time has no lower bound and only establishes annotation no later than 2019, so the evidence does not establish that David Motl was valid at or near the actual reference time; a supersession verdict therefore cannot be assigned conservatively.
